annotations.title: State paid family and medical leave premium calculator

description: Estimate state paid family and medical leave or disability premiums for your employees, split between employee withholding and employer cost. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.
